reasons: Per-batch MAE ranges from 3.2 to 14.8; batch 7 dominates the error, as the data contract warned.

concerns.description: Aggregate MAE hides that one batch accounts for a third of total error.

follow_up.hypothesis: Monotonic constraints on temp and dose reduce the per-batch error spread without hurting mean MAE.
follow_up.rationale: Yield should not decrease with dose in the studied range; constraining the trees may stabilize high-variance batches.
